sections.notes: Put-in Boxley: exact agency access pin. Take-out Ponca: exact agency access pin. Buffalo National River compendium: "The rafting of three or more canoes, kayaks, inner tubes, river rafts, boats or any floatable vessel to make “Flotillas” is prohibited.". Buffalo National River general regulations: except for a vessel with an internal combustion engine rated 10 horsepower or less, operating a motorized vessel from Erbie Ford to the White River is prohibited. Arkansas law: no glass containers in canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in sealed containers, carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat and use floating drink holders; children 12 and under wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: NPS Buffalo National River river miles.

sections.notes: Put-in Gilbert: exact agency access pin. Take-out South Maumee: exact agency access pin.
